name: VisualWebBench
intro: VisualWebBench 是评估MLLM网页理解与接地能力的多模态基准，7项任务覆盖网页、元素和用户动作三个层级，包括页面描述、WebQA、标题/元素OCR、元素接地、动作预测和动作接地。
metric: ROUGE-L（描述与OCR）、SQuAD式F1（WebQA）、准确率（接地与动作选择题）
task_type: 网页视觉理解, GUI接地
scale: 1,534个样本、7项任务，覆盖12个领域、87个子领域和139个真实网站
intro_en: VisualWebBench is a multimodal benchmark for webpage understanding and grounding in MLLMs. Its seven tasks span webpage-, element-, and user-action-level capabilities, including captioning, WebQA, heading/element OCR, element grounding, action prediction, and action grounding.
scale_en: 1,534 instances across seven tasks, 12 domains, 87 subdomains, and 139 real websites
metric_en: ROUGE-L (captioning and OCR), SQuAD-style F1 (WebQA), and Accuracy (grounding and action MCQs)
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2404.05955v1, Sections 3.1-3.4 and Appendix B; official dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/visualwebbench/VisualWebBench. Section 3.2 specifies representative websites selected from each subdomain's top five, while Section 3.1 and the official dataset report 139 websites. Appendix B specifies collaborative verification and curation with a division of tasks by two authors, not a per-sample two-signature gate.. VisualWebBench starts from 12 SimilarWeb domains and 87 subdomains, manually selecting representative websites from the top five sites in each subdomain and excluding sites used by Mind2Web or WebArena; the resulting benchmark spans 139 websites. Playwright renders 1280-pixel-wide screenshots, and seven task-specific pipelines produce 1,534 samples. Verification and curation are collaboratively divided between two authors; the paper does not define a per-sample double-approval gate. The seven task counts are 134/314/46/245/413/281/101.
